Honeywell — Mission Ready AR game

Mobile AR Game Design iOS / Android

Mission Ready is an augmented-reality mobile game for Honeywell, bundling two games playable in either AR or a standard 2D view.

Designed in collaboration with Happy Finish, covering game UI, UX and the AR interaction model.
